status.primary_verified: Read directly from the issuer's own page; source_url must be on an issuer domain.
status.secondary_reported: Seen in a third-party article or search summary. Plausible, not verified.
status.conflicting: Sources disagree. See conflicts[]. Not usable until resolved.
status.unsourced: From model memory, no source found. Not usable until sourced.

_schema.evidence: page_read = full page was read; search_summary = only a search-result summary was seen
_schema.quote: primary_verified claims carry an exact quote (whitespace-normalised) that cardtool.py checks against evidence_file.
_schema.evidence_file: Saved page text (rendered with headless Chromium) under credit-cards/evidence/.
